title: Record V4 Guards 1.2.2 publication and verification
goal: Capture the exact 1.2.2 release commit, certification, immutable asset identities, safety checkpoints and fresh-download Windows/Linux verification without changing published bytes.
acceptanceCriteria: The report records the repair and release-preparation PRs, exact release source, annotated tag and non-draft, non-prerelease GitHub Release with exactly four assets.
The report records passing full Guardrails and dual-platform Certification, matching source packageHash, both RID package identities, archive SHA-256 values and recovery source.
The report records byte-identical independent builds plus fresh-download hash, install, public API, four Stage, Companion and verified-uninstall results on Windows and network-isolated Linux.
The report preserves P03 FAIL, A1/B3 gaps and the absence of IFX adoption or protection; base-owned Contract, Linux, package, Windows and required checks pass.
risks: Confusing the clean source packageHash, RID package identity and ZIP hash would misstate provenance.
Post-publication status documentation changes current main package identity but must not be confused with or replace the immutable release source and assets.
decisions: Record the release source as the tag's peeled commit and preserve all published bytes.
Disclose the superseded local preflight identity caused by ignored diagnostic obj output; use only the clean identity that matches both platform reports.
Preserve P03 FAIL and keep consumer adoption and activation separately governed.
validationCommands: v4-windows when selected by the trusted-base Contract
